import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int x, y, n;

    static int nod(int a, int b) {
        if (a == 0)
            return b;
        else if (b == 0)
            return a;
        return nod(b, a % b);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        long a = 0, b = 0;

        if (n >= y) {
            int m = nod(x, y);
            a = x / m;
            b = y / m;
        } else {
            double m = 1000050000.0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                double aa = Math.floor((double) x * i / y);
                if (Math.abs(aa / i - (double) x / y) < m) {
                    a = (long) aa;
                    b = i;
                    m = Math.abs(aa / i - (double) x / y);
                }

                aa = Math.ceil((double) x * i / y);
                if (Math.abs(aa / i - (double) x / y) < m) {
                    a = (long) aa;
                    b = i;
                    m = Math.abs(aa / i - (double) x / y);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
    }
}
